title: A gap theorem for metric solitons and its applications
summary: In this paper, we prove a gap theorem for $\mathbb{F}$-limit metric solitons with respect to the asymptotic volume ratio (AVR): if the AVR of a metric soliton is sufficiently close to 1, then the metric soliton is Euclidean; this is a metric-soliton counterpart of Wang-Wang.
